disputes.description: The schema allows one signature; this packet-level contract reports the signature of the primary entry 0x004AA270 (__fastcall int,int -> void). The other 24 packet functions each have their own ABI (mostly __thiscall) that a single record cannot express; per-function signatures belong in finer-grained contracts.

Hex-Rays labels 0x004AA270 __fastcall(a1,a2) with a2 unused in the visible body; a1 is a large object root, consistent with a member/this-style initializer, but the convention is not independently confirmed.

The inline option entries at options_table+0x200 use a 36-byte stride (int/float variant, fields at +0x14/+0x18/+0x1C/+0x20) while byte-valued entries use a 24-byte stride (fields +0x14..0x17) and short-valued entries write words at +0x14/+0x16/+0x18/+0x1A; no constructor or type declaration in the packet proves the struct name.

0x004B6C90 and 0x004B7300 share the same this convention and overlapping field offsets (0x6C0..0x720, 0xF1C..0xF34), but no caller or constructor in the packet proves they own the same object; the shared pattern is recorded as a fact, not an ownership claim.
